boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Susquehanna rituals that mark arrivals, service, seasonal gatherings and the path to graduation.

cards.title: Move-In Day
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Watch for Orientation Team volunteers helping incoming students carry belongings, then use the day to learn the campus arrival routine.
cards.short_summary: Returning students help welcome the incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna identifies Move-In Day as a tradition where returning Orientation Team students assist incoming students with moving in.
cards.access_notes: Occurs with the university's new-student move-in programming; confirm current timing with the university.

cards.title: Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Attend or photograph the formal start-of-year ceremony, where new students and supporters hear university leaders and the faculty marshal.
cards.short_summary: A formal welcome that opens Susquehanna’s academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna describes Opening Convocation as an annual event beginning the academic year, with leaders’ addresses and a formal opening by the faculty marshal.
cards.access_notes: Annual academic-year opening; confirm the current ceremony schedule before attending.

cards.title: Orange & Maroon Day
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Wear orange and maroon for the annual pre-Labor Day campus-color tradition, and use official prompts if you choose to share a photo.
cards.short_summary: The campus marks school pride in its two signature colors.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Orange & Maroon Day is held annually before Labor Day and encourages the community to wear orange and maroon and share photos.
cards.access_notes: Annual event before Labor Day; check current university communications for participation details.

cards.title: Thanksgiving Dinner
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Join the November campus meal if eligible, and look for the faculty and staff who serve students at the holiday gathering.
cards.short_summary: A November holiday feast served to students by campus employees.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna documents a November Thanksgiving feast in which faculty and staff serve students.
cards.access_notes: November campus event; confirm current eligibility, reservations and dining arrangements with the university.

cards.title: Christmas Candlelight Service
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Experience the seasonal service respectfully; the documented program includes readings, carols, prayers and a candlelit closing rendition of Silent Night.
cards.short_summary: A candlelit seasonal service centered on music and readings.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna describes its Christmas Candlelight Service as featuring readings, carols and prayers, culminating in a candlelit rendition of Silent Night.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal service; verify the current date, venue and attendance guidance with the university.

cards.title: Mid-Year Graduates Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Celebrate December degree completion at this separate ceremony, which includes remarks from the university president and a faculty member.
cards.short_summary: Susquehanna gives mid-year graduates their own recognition ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna states that it honors mid-year graduates in a ceremony with remarks from President Jonathan Green and a distinguished faculty member.
cards.access_notes: For mid-year graduates and invited guests; verify current ceremony information with the university.

cards.title: MLK Convocation
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Start the spring term with the university’s Winter Convocation, listening for student music and the keynote’s reflection on Dr. King’s legacy.
cards.short_summary: A spring-semester opening ceremony linked to Dr. King’s legacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Winter Convocation officially starts the spring semester and often includes student music and a keynote reflecting on Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s legacy.
cards.access_notes: Held at the start of spring semester; check the university calendar for the current program.

cards.title: SU SERVE
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Choose an announced service opportunity and follow organizer instructions; SU SERVE connects the campus community with local and global organizations.
cards.short_summary: A Susquehanna service tradition extending beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna describes SU SERVE as service by students, faculty, staff, alumni and parents for local and global organizations.
cards.access_notes: Opportunities and requirements vary by project; use current university service announcements.

cards.title: Senior Hike
cards.subtitle: Mount Mahanoy, led by Susquehanna University
cards.notes: If invited as a graduating senior, prepare for the documented Mount Mahanoy trek and follow university guidance for the hike and summit gathering.
cards.short_summary: Graduating seniors hike Mount Mahanoy with the university president.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna identifies the Senior Hike as a tradition dating to the 19th century: a Mount Mahanoy trek led by the university president.
cards.access_notes: For graduating seniors; participation details, route and safety guidance should come from current university organizers.

cards.title: Commencement and Baccalaureate
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University, Selinsgrove
cards.notes: Mark graduation through the main ceremony and Baccalaureate, a non-religious service featuring student speakers, musicians and class reflections.
cards.short_summary: Graduation includes both the main ceremony and a student-centered Baccalaureate.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna states that Commencement traditions include the main ceremony and Baccalaureate, a non-religious service with student speakers, musicians and reflections.
cards.access_notes: Annual graduation programming; current schedules and guest information are published by the university.
